chemistry-m1-q2.title: Heerkulka joogtada ah, volume-ka
chemistry-m1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m1-q2.material: Heerkulka joogtada ah, volume-ka gaaska waxaa uu ahaa 60 mL cadaadiska 1 atm, cadaadiskana waxaa loo kordhiyay 3 atm. Sida uu qabo sharciga Boyle, volume-ka gaaska waa imisa?

chemistry-m1-c.title: [Xawaaraha faafidda] Dhamaadka labada
chemistry-m1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m1-c.material: [Xawaaraha faafidda] Dhamaadka labada dhinac ee tuubo muraayad dheer ah waxaa lagu dhex geliyay cudbi lagu qoyay ammonia xooggan (miisaanka molikiyuulka 17) iyo cudbi lagu qoyay hydrochloric acid xooggan (36.5) isla markaas, waxaana lagu xidhay xidhaha rubber-ka ah. Muddo yar kadib, tuubada gudaheeda waxaa soo baxday xariiq qiiq cad ah (ammonium chloride). Xariiqdaas meel ma ku dhow tahay?

chemistry-killer-07.title: Xaaladda caadiga ah (STP,
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; gaas 1 mol = 22.4 L), mugga isku-darka gaaska ka kooban methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) iyo carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) waa 11.2 L, cufkuna waa 16.4 g. Culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, C=12, O=16, lambarka Avogadro-na waa $N_A$. Waa imisa wadarta tirada atomyada ku jira isku-darkan gaaska ah?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; gaas 1 mol = 22.4 L), mugga isku-darka gaaska ka kooban methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) iyo carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) waa 11.2 L, cufkuna waa 16.4 g. Culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, C=12, O=16, lambarka Avogadro-na waa $N_A$. Waa imisa wadarta tirada atomyada ku jira isku-darkan gaaska ah?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Wadarta mole = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Tallaabo 2: Cufka: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Ku beddel y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Tallaabo 3: Tirada atomyada: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ waxay leedahay 5 atom molecule kasta → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ waxay leedahay 3 atom molecule kasta → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Wadar 1.9 mol atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Jawaab: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 1.5 waxaa loo qaatay dhammaan CO2, 2.5 waxaa loo qaatay dhammaan CH4, 1.7 waxay tirisay atomyada CH4 kaliya 4 H.)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
